task.title: Phase L L1 (awkit-djnl.1): real inference host on node-llama-cpp, runtime pin and measured model-pack manifest entry
task.objective: Complete the L1 runtime binding chosen in docs/plans/ai-upgrade-v5/L1-ai-foundation.md: write the raw utility-process host native-hosts/ai/ai-host.cjs on node-llama-cpp 3.21.1 (llama.cpp v0.4.0) behind the existing AiHostProtocol, then pin AI_RUNTIME_PIN and the first AiModelManifest entry in src/offline/AiModelManifest.ts only from values measured on the downloaded Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M pack. The install and the download are owner steps because the lease guard admits no install or network command. Ordinary L1 code under src/ai, app/main, scripts and docs is unleased direct-loop work, disclosed rather than hidden.

acceptance.description: The raw host answers the AiHostProtocol (hello, load, infer, cancel, unload, shutdown) with stable path-free reason codes, refuses model paths outside the fork-time root, unconstrained or thinking-enabled inference and over-long prompts, and never logs or persists a prompt or a response.

history.released_reason: AI host native-hosts/ai/ai-host.cjs written and syntax-checked, runtime verification follows under unleased verifiers
